subject.title: [Feature]: Per-bot context isolation in multi-bot Feishu groups - only record context when mentioned

question: Should Feishu mention-gated groups keep recording unmentioned messages as ambient history, or should OpenClaw add an opt-in mention-only/per-bot context policy, and what default should existing users keep?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public Feishu configuration and compatibility-sensitive group-history semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent default or config contract alone.

options.title: Add Opt-In Mention-Only Context
options.body: Preserve current ambient-history behavior by default while adding a documented Feishu policy that records context only for messages addressed to the current bot.

options.title: Redefine requireMention Semantics
options.body: Make `requireMention: true` stop recording unmentioned group messages by default, accepting a more surprising compatibility change for existing groups.

options.title: Defer To Generic Target Metadata
options.body: Keep Feishu unchanged until the broader group-history target-attribution work defines a shared channel/plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Mention-Only Context
recommendation.body: Preserve current ambient-history behavior by default while adding a documented Feishu policy that records context only for messages addressed to the current bot.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is Feishu-plugin specific and the plugin metadata identifies m1heng as the community maintenance owner for this channel.
